basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. When I'm not coding, I'm usually found orchestrating intricate D&D campaigns for my friends. I have a keen interest in technology, especially anything related to Apple products, and I tend to spend my evenings exploring new gadgets or catching up on the latest tech news. I'm in a committed relationship and we both enjoy binge-watching series like ER during weekends. My typical online hours are in the evening after work, and I frequently dive into discussions about gaming and tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for about three years. My interest in D&D started in college where I joined a tabletop RPG club. I have since honed my skills through countless campaigns, both as a player and a Dungeon Master. Additionally, my fascination with technology is both a professional and personal interest, driven by continuous learning and exploration.
